cases.name: gateway-prefix-overlap
cases.error: LANIPv4Prefixes must be disjoint without duplicate or overlapping prefixes

cases.name: gateway-prefix-host-bits
cases.error: LANIPv4Prefixes entry 0 requires a canonical IPv4 network prefix /8 through /32 without host bits

cases.name: gateway-prefix-not-rfc1918
cases.error: LANIPv4Prefixes entry 0 must be wholly inside RFC1918 space

cases.name: gateway-prefix-count-limit
cases.error: gateway requires 1 to 8 declared IPv4 LAN prefixes

cases.name: gateway-present-empty-client-list
cases.error: gateway forbids exact client addresses, client lists and MAC maps

cases.name: devices-mac-coverage-missing
cases.error: ClientMACs: every selected IPv4 and active IPv6 client requires an exact source MAC

cases.name: devices-wildcard-lan
cases.error: LANInterface must be a safe, exact interface name of 1 to 15 bytes (no wildcard)

cases.name: devices-unowned-tun
cases.error: TUNInterface must be a distinct owned b6p- interface name of 5 to 15 bytes (no alias or wildcard)

cases.name: devices-tun-not-first-host
cases.error: TUNAddress must be the first usable /30 host so the next host is its usable peer

cases.name: gateway-tun-overlaps-lan
cases.error: TUNAddress /30 overlaps a declared LAN prefix

cases.name: devices-tun-collides-client
cases.error: TUNAddress /30 collides with a selected client

cases.name: devices-tun-collides-management
cases.error: TUNAddress /30 collides with management or endpoint addresses

cases.name: devices-tun-collides-endpoint
cases.error: TUNAddress /30 collides with management or endpoint addresses

cases.name: devices-ipv6-follow-unqualified
cases.error: routed-tun requires IPv6 direct in the initial qualified phase

cases.name: devices-ipv6-block-unqualified
cases.error: routed-tun requires IPv6 direct in the initial qualified phase

cases.name: devices-failure-block-proxy
cases.error: block-proxy requires a surviving stateful DNS/flow classifier; dropping all selected-client traffic is not selective blocking

cases.name: gateway-zero-ports
cases.error: gateway Mixed and DNS listener ports must be actual, nonzero and distinct

cases.name: devices-listener-port-collision
cases.error: Mixed port must not share a TProxy or DNS listener port

cases.name: devices-client-count-limit
cases.error: ClientIPv4/ClientIPv4s: at most 64 exact clients per family

cases.name: devices-unused-tproxy-noncanonical
cases.error: routed-tun requires the unused compatibility TProxy port 7893

cases.name: devices-router-dns-not-management
cases.error: RouterDNSAddresses must be unicast router LAN addresses also present in ManagementIPs
